name: Wild Musume no Oya Koukou
source:
Tomomi Oe had no luck with love due to her masculine personality.
She is devoted to her father and comforts him every night in place of her late mother.
However, one day, the man she admired confessed to her and they started dating.
Tomomi is happy with her first lover, but her relationship with her father gets in the way of her love life...

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ137796.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
由于男性化的性格，大江朋美在爱情上并不顺利。
她忠于父亲，每天晚上代替已故的母亲安慰他。
然而有一天，她崇拜的男人向她告白，他们开始约会。
朋美和她的初恋情人在一起很幸福，但她和父亲的关系却阻碍了她的爱情生活……
